name: Turn one sentence into a narrated, subtitled animated video
tagline: Write what you want to explain and download a finished MP4
description: Explainer Video Generator writes, voices and animates a short video from one sentence describing what you want to explain. Enter the idea, pick landscape or vertical, and the tool produces the script, narration, subtitles, background music and a cover image, delivered as an MP4. Plans start at $19/month; credits are refunded if a film fails.
